title: Alumni reunion: 50 years of maritime tradition
summary: Alumni of different years returned to their university to meet teachers and students.

body.text: The university hosted its annual alumni reunion. Guests visited the renovated laboratories, museum and classrooms and joined a round table on the development of maritime education.
Alumni highlighted the importance of mentoring and proposed internship programmes for senior students.
